notes: Exact expert offload never changes which expert runs, so it preserves accuracy by construction; the whole cost is latency (measured in clausius, https://github.com/beatakouchnir/clausius — findings F3-F6: an offloaded 35B at 3.40 GB scores 0.9447 on gsm8k where a natively-fitting 4B at 3.91 GB scores 0.8426; same ordering on popqa +13.9pp and mmlu_pro +20.9pp).
Quantization is the axis that can hurt, and task-dependently: under the same 4-bit quant, factual QA loses ~1.5pp where structured generation loses 18-21pp (clausius F11).
boyle forecasts speed; it never forecasts accuracy. Rows below are measurements, present only where someone measured.

rows.reference: bf16 source scores 0.844 on the same probe
rows.note: The cliff is between 3 and 4 bits: 3-bit scores 0.278, 2-bit is gibberish. Every sub-4-bit artifact is dominated.
